passage:
CALL FOR PAPERS — 12th Annual Coastal Marketing Summit
October 14–15, Harborview Convention Center, Port Sheldon
The program committee invites abstracts for presentations on consumer analytics, regional branding, and digital outreach. Abstracts may not exceed 250 words and must be submitted through our Web site by June 20. Speakers may request either a 30-minute or a 45-minute session. All accepted presenters receive complimentary summit registration. Notification of acceptance will be sent by July 15.

--- Passage 2 ---
ABSTRACT SUBMISSION — Coastal Marketing Summit
Submission date: June 18
Name: Dr. Elena Vasquez | Affiliation: Brightwave Analytics
Presentation title: Predicting Consumer Trends with Regional Data
Requested session length: 45 minutes
Abstract word count: 238
Note from submitter: This is my first time presenting at the summit, and I would prefer an afternoon time slot if possible.

--- Passage 3 ---
To: e.vasquez@brightwave.com
From: program@coastalsummit.org
Date: July 10
Subject: Your submission — Decision

Dear Dr. Vasquez,
Congratulations! The committee has accepted your presentation for this year's summit. Because all of the longer session blocks were filled by returning speakers, we can offer you a 30-minute slot on October 15 at 2:30 P.M. Please confirm your participation by July 24. Your complimentary registration code, SPKR-1145, can be entered on the registration page. Kindly upload your presentation slides to the speaker portal no later than October 1.
We look forward to seeing you in Port Sheldon.
Sincerely,
Marcus Lee, Program Chair

questions.question: What is the purpose of the first passage?
options: To announce a change of venue for a summit
To invite proposals for conference presentations
To advertise discounted registration rates
To recruit volunteers for an annual event
questions.explanation: 첫 번째 지문은 'The program committee invites abstracts for presentations'라고 하며 학회 발표 제안서(초록) 제출을 요청하는 Call for Papers입니다. 장소 변경, 할인 등록, 자원봉사 모집에 대한 내용은 없으므로 발표 제안 요청이 정답입니다.

questions.question: What is suggested about Dr. Vasquez's abstract?
options: It was submitted after the deadline.
It exceeded the maximum word count.
It satisfied the submission requirements.
It was co-written with a returning speaker.
questions.explanation: 두 지문을 연계해야 하는 문제입니다. 공고문에서 초록은 250단어 이하, 6월 20일까지 제출이라고 했는데, 제출 양식을 보면 6월 18일에 제출했고 단어 수가 238로 제한 이내입니다. 따라서 제출 요건을 모두 충족했음을 알 수 있습니다.

questions.question: What aspect of Dr. Vasquez's request could NOT be accommodated?
options: Her preferred session length
Her preferred time of day
Her request for free registration
Her request to present on the first day
questions.explanation: 제출 양식에서 Dr. Vasquez는 45분 세션을 요청했지만, 수락 이메일에서는 '긴 세션 블록이 모두 찼기 때문에 30분 슬롯을 제공한다'고 했습니다. 오후 시간대 희망(2:30 P.M. 배정)은 반영되었으므로, 수용되지 못한 것은 세션 길이입니다. 두 지문을 비교해야 풀 수 있는 연계 문제입니다.

questions.question: According to the e-mail, what must Dr. Vasquez do by July 24?
options: Upload her presentation slides
Confirm that she will participate
Pay her registration fee
Submit a revised abstract
questions.explanation: 이메일에 'Please confirm your participation by July 24'라고 명시되어 있으므로 7월 24일까지 참가 여부를 확정해야 합니다. 슬라이드 업로드 기한은 10월 1일이며, 발표자는 무료 등록 대상이므로 등록비 납부는 해당되지 않습니다.

questions.question: What is most likely true about Dr. Vasquez's summit registration?
options: She will not have to pay for it.
She must register before July 15.
It includes hotel accommodations.
It is valid for October 14 only.
questions.explanation: 공고문에서 '모든 채택된 발표자는 무료 등록(complimentary registration)을 받는다'고 했고, 이메일에서 발표가 채택되었으며 무료 등록 코드 SPKR-1145가 제공되었습니다. 세 지문의 정보를 종합하면 그녀는 등록비를 내지 않아도 됨을 알 수 있습니다.

passage:
FOR LEASE — Merchant's Row Tower, Suite 410
2,800 square feet of open-plan office space on the fourth floor. Rent: $4,200 per month; minimum lease term of three years. Two reserved parking spaces included. Tenants pay their own utilities. Available September 1. Large windows, recently updated elevators, and a five-minute walk to Central Station. To arrange a tour, contact Dana Whitfield, Pinnacle Realty, at d.whitfield@pinnaclerealty.com.

--- Passage 2 ---
MEMO
To: Renata Kowalski, CEO
From: Tom Garza, Operations Manager
Date: July 8
Re: Tour of Merchant's Row Tower, Suite 410

I toured the suite this morning. The space is bright, the layout suits our team of twenty, and the location near transit is ideal. However, the carpet is badly worn throughout, and only two parking spaces are included even though we need four for our sales staff. I recommend we offer $3,900 per month and ask the landlord to replace the carpet before we move in.

--- Passage 3 ---
To: t.garza@kowalskiconsulting.com
From: d.whitfield@pinnaclerealty.com
Date: July 15
Subject: Suite 410 — Owner's response

Dear Mr. Garza,
Thank you for your interest in Suite 410. I have discussed your terms with the building's owner. He is willing to replace the carpet in the entire suite before your move-in date. He can also offer two additional reserved parking spaces at $75 each per month. The monthly rent, however, must remain at $4,200; instead, he will waive the first month's rent entirely on a three-year lease. Please let me know by July 22 whether you would like to proceed with a lease agreement.
Best regards,
Dana Whitfield

questions.question: What is indicated about Suite 410 in the listing?
options: Utility costs are included in the rent.
It must be leased for at least three years.
It is located on the ground floor.
It becomes available on July 1.
questions.explanation: 매물 광고에 'minimum lease term of three years'라고 명시되어 있으므로 최소 3년 임대가 정답입니다. 공과금은 세입자 부담이고, 4층에 위치하며, 입주 가능일은 9월 1일이므로 나머지는 모두 오답입니다.

questions.question: In the memo, what concern does Mr. Garza mention?
options: The suite is too small for his team.
The building is far from public transportation.
The number of parking spaces is insufficient.
The elevators need to be repaired.
questions.explanation: 메모에서 'only two parking spaces are included even though we need four'라고 하여 주차 공간 부족을 우려하고 있습니다. 공간은 20명 팀에 적합하고, 교통이 편리하며, 엘리베이터는 최근 교체되었다고 했으므로 나머지는 오답입니다.

questions.question: Which of Mr. Garza's requests did the owner fully agree to?
options: Lowering the monthly rent
Replacing the carpet
Shortening the lease term
Including utilities in the rent
questions.explanation: 메모에서 Garza는 월세를 $3,900로 낮추고 카펫을 교체해 달라고 제안했는데, 이메일에서 소유주는 카펫 전체 교체에는 동의했지만 월세는 $4,200를 유지하겠다고 했습니다. 두 지문을 비교해야 하는 연계 문제로, 완전히 수용된 요구는 카펫 교체입니다.

questions.question: If Mr. Garza's company leases the suite, how much extra would it pay each month for four parking spaces?
options: Nothing
questions.explanation: 세 지문 연계 문제입니다. 광고에 따르면 주차 공간 2개는 임대료에 포함되어 있고, 메모에서 회사는 총 4개가 필요하다고 했습니다. 이메일에서 추가 공간은 개당 월 $75에 제공한다고 했으므로, 추가 2개에 대해 월 $150를 더 내면 됩니다.

questions.question: What incentive does the owner offer?
options: A rent-free first month
A discount on utilities
Free use of a conference room
An extra year on the lease at no cost
questions.explanation: 이메일에서 소유주는 월세 인하 대신 'he will waive the first month's rent entirely on a three-year lease'라고 하여 3년 계약 시 첫 달 임대료를 면제해 주겠다고 제안했습니다.

passage:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE — Nimbus Home Tech
Nimbus Home Tech announces the AeroPure 5, its quietest air purifier yet, arriving in stores on May 5. The AeroPure 5 features a washable pre-filter, a three-stage purification system, and a sleep mode that operates at just 18 decibels. Suggested retail price: $249. To celebrate the launch, retailers that order 50 or more units before April 10 will receive a 10% discount off the wholesale price. Launch-period orders will be shipped to retailers in late April. For wholesale inquiries, contact sales@nimbushometech.com.

--- Passage 2 ---
PURCHASE ORDER #HH-3057 — Hartley's Home Goods
Date: April 8
Supplier: Nimbus Home Tech
Item: AeroPure 5 air purifier — 60 units
Wholesale price: $140.00 per unit, less 10% launch discount = $126.00 per unit
Order total: $7,560.00
Deliver to: Hartley's Home Goods, 88 Brookfield Avenue
Requested delivery date: on or before April 28

--- Passage 3 ---
NOTICE TO RETAIL PARTNERS
From: Nimbus Home Tech Distribution Team
Date: April 22

Due to an unexpected delay at the facility that produces the AeroPure 5's pre-filters, we are unable to ship some launch orders in full. Orders placed after April 5 will be shipped in two installments: half of the ordered units will arrive by April 28, and the remaining units will follow by May 12. All launch discounts will be honored on both installments. Retailers affected by this change may cancel the second installment without penalty by contacting us before May 1. We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of the press release?
options: To announce the release of a new product
To explain a change in company leadership
To recall a defective appliance
To report record quarterly earnings
questions.explanation: 보도자료는 신제품 공기청정기 AeroPure 5의 5월 5일 출시를 알리는 내용입니다. 제품 특징, 권장 소비자 가격, 출시 기념 도매 할인까지 소개하고 있으므로 신제품 출시 발표가 목적입니다.

questions.question: Why did Hartley's Home Goods receive a discount?
options: It paid for its order in advance.
It ordered more than 50 units before April 10.
It is a long-standing distribution partner.
It agreed to a delayed delivery date.
questions.explanation: 보도자료에서 '4월 10일 전에 50대 이상 주문하는 소매업체는 도매가 10% 할인'이라고 했고, 주문서를 보면 Hartley's는 4월 8일에 60대를 주문하여 조건을 충족했습니다. 두 지문을 연계해야 할인 사유를 알 수 있습니다.

questions.question: How many air purifiers will Hartley's Home Goods most likely receive by April 28?
questions.explanation: 공지에 따르면 4월 5일 이후 접수된 주문은 두 번에 나누어 배송되며, 주문 수량의 절반이 4월 28일까지 도착합니다. Hartley's는 4월 8일에 60대를 주문했으므로 절반인 30대를 4월 28일까지 받게 됩니다. 주문서와 공지를 연계한 계산 문제입니다.

questions.question: According to the notice, what caused the shipping problem?
options: A shortage of delivery drivers
A delay at a filter production facility
Unusually high consumer demand
Damage to a company warehouse
questions.explanation: 공지 첫 문장에서 'Due to an unexpected delay at the facility that produces the AeroPure 5's pre-filters'라고 하여 프리필터 생산 시설의 지연이 원인임을 밝히고 있습니다.

questions.question: What is Hartley's Home Goods invited to do before May 1?
options: Cancel the second part of its shipment
Reorder at a higher discount rate
Return any unsold units
Update its delivery address
questions.explanation: 공지에서 '영향을 받은 소매업체는 5월 1일 전에 연락하면 위약금 없이 두 번째 배송분을 취소할 수 있다'고 했습니다. Hartley's의 주문은 4월 5일 이후에 접수되어 분할 배송 대상이므로 이 선택권이 적용됩니다. 두 지문을 연계해야 하는 문제입니다.

passage:
LAKESIDE CULINARY FESTIVAL — AMATEUR COOK-OFF RULES
Saturday, August 9, Lakeside Park Pavilion
1. The competition is open to amateur cooks only; professional chefs are not eligible.
2. Each dish must feature at least one ingredient sourced from a farm within the county.
3. Contestants will have 90 minutes to prepare their dish on site.
4. A panel of three judges will award up to 50 points for taste, 30 for presentation, and 20 for creativity.
5. The three highest-scoring contestants will receive prizes.
Entry forms are due by July 25.

--- Passage 2 ---
ENTRY FORM — Lakeside Culinary Festival Amateur Cook-Off
Date submitted: July 20
Name: Marcus Bell
Dish name: Smoked Trout Chowder with Sweet Corn
Locally sourced ingredient: Sweet corn from Hadley Farms
Equipment needed: One portable burner
[X] I confirm that I am an amateur cook and do not earn income from cooking.

--- Passage 3 ---
JUDGES' SCORE SHEET — Contestant No. 11: Marcus Bell
Taste: 46 / 50
Presentation: 22 / 30
Creativity: 18 / 20
Total: 86 / 100 — SECOND PLACE
Comments: The chowder's flavor was superb, with a beautifully balanced smokiness, and pairing trout with sweet corn was a clever regional touch. The plating, however, could be more refined; the garnish looked rushed. We encourage Mr. Bell to participate in next year's Rising Cooks Showcase, to which he is hereby invited.

questions.question: According to the rules, what must every dish include?
options: A seafood component
An ingredient from a local farm
A vegetarian option
A printed recipe card
questions.explanation: 규정 2번에서 '각 요리는 카운티 내 농장에서 조달한 재료를 최소 한 가지 포함해야 한다'고 명시했습니다. 해산물이나 채식 옵션, 레시피 카드에 대한 요구사항은 없습니다.

questions.question: How did Mr. Bell satisfy rule 2 of the competition?
options: By using trout he caught in the lake
By using corn from Hadley Farms
By preparing his dish at a local farm
By buying all ingredients at a farmers market
questions.explanation: 규정 2번은 지역 농장 재료 사용을 요구하는데, 참가 신청서에 'Locally sourced ingredient: Sweet corn from Hadley Farms'라고 기재되어 있습니다. 규정과 신청서를 연계해야 풀 수 있는 문제입니다.

questions.question: In which category did Mr. Bell earn the lowest share of the available points?
options: Taste
Presentation
Creativity
He scored equally in all categories.
questions.explanation: 규정의 배점(맛 50점, 플레이팅 30점, 창의성 20점)과 채점표의 점수를 비교해야 하는 연계 문제입니다. 맛은 46/50(92%), 플레이팅은 22/30(약 73%), 창의성은 18/20(90%)이므로 만점 대비 득점 비율이 가장 낮은 항목은 플레이팅입니다. 심사평에서도 플레이팅 보완을 지적했습니다.

questions.question: What is suggested about Mr. Bell?
options: He will receive a prize.
He has competed at the festival before.
He is a professional chef.
He submitted his entry form late.
questions.explanation: 규정 5번에서 '최고 득점 3명이 상을 받는다'고 했고, 채점표에서 Bell은 86점으로 2위를 차지했습니다. 따라서 그는 상을 받게 됩니다. 신청서에서 아마추어임을 확인했고 7월 20일에 기한 내 제출했으므로 나머지 선택지는 오답입니다. 두 지문을 연계해야 하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: What are the judges encouraging Mr. Bell to do?
options: Open his own restaurant
Take part in a future showcase
Apply to be a judge next year
Revise his chowder recipe
questions.explanation: 심사평 마지막에 'We encourage Mr. Bell to participate in next year's Rising Cooks Showcase, to which he is hereby invited'라고 하여 내년 Rising Cooks Showcase 참가를 권하며 초청하고 있습니다.

passage:
WESTBROOK BUSINESS PARK — EMPLOYEE SHUTTLE SCHEDULE
Route A (Central Station ↔ Business Park): departs Central Station every 20 minutes from 7:00 A.M. to 9:40 A.M. Stops: Central Station, Fairview Avenue, Westbrook Main Gate.
Route B (Elm Street Garage ↔ Business Park): departs every 30 minutes from 7:15 A.M. to 9:45 A.M.
Evening service: shuttles depart the Main Gate every 25 minutes; final departure at 6:50 P.M.
The shuttle is free for all business park employees with a valid ID badge.

--- Passage 2 ---
SERVICE NOTICE — June 2
Beginning Monday, June 16, Route A shuttles will not stop at Fairview Avenue because of bridge repairs expected to last approximately eight weeks. During this period, riders should use the temporary stop on Garner Street, two blocks north of the Fairview Avenue stop. Route B service is unaffected. Also effective June 16, the final evening departure from the Main Gate will be extended to 7:20 P.M. in response to rider requests. Questions may be sent to shuttle@westbrookpark.com.

--- Passage 3 ---
To: shuttle@westbrookpark.com
From: a.chen@meridiansoft.com
Date: June 18
Subject: Route A temporary stop

Hello,
I ride Route A every day, and the temporary stop has added a ten-minute walk to my commute, which is difficult when I am carrying equipment. Would it be possible to add a stop at Milton Plaza, which is much closer to my building? On a positive note, I want to thank you for the later evening departure. I usually work until 7:00 P.M., so I was never able to catch the last shuttle before this change. Could you also confirm when the Fairview Avenue stop will reopen?
Thank you,
Alyssa Chen

questions.question: According to the schedule, how often does Route A depart in the morning?
options: Every 20 minutes
Every 25 minutes
Every 30 minutes
Every hour
questions.explanation: 시간표에 Route A는 오전 7시부터 9시 40분까지 'every 20 minutes' 간격으로 Central Station에서 출발한다고 명시되어 있습니다. 25분 간격은 저녁 운행, 30분 간격은 Route B에 해당합니다.

questions.question: Why is the Fairview Avenue stop temporarily closed?
options: A new shuttle route is being tested.
A bridge is being repaired.
The street is being repaved.
Ridership at the stop was too low.
questions.explanation: 공지에서 'because of bridge repairs expected to last approximately eight weeks'라고 하여 교량 보수 공사 때문에 Fairview Avenue 정류장이 임시 폐쇄됨을 알 수 있습니다.

questions.question: Why is Ms. Chen pleased about one of the changes?
options: Her commute is now ten minutes shorter.
She can now take the shuttle after finishing work.
Route B now stops near her building.
The shuttle is now free for employees.
questions.explanation: 공지에서 마지막 저녁 출발이 6시 50분에서 7시 20분으로 연장되었고, 이메일에서 Chen은 '보통 7시까지 일해서 이전에는 마지막 셔틀을 탈 수 없었다'며 감사를 표했습니다. 두 지문을 연계하면 근무 종료 후에도 셔틀을 탈 수 있게 된 것이 기뻐하는 이유임을 알 수 있습니다.

questions.question: When will the Fairview Avenue stop most likely reopen?
options: In late June
In mid-July
In mid-August
In early October
questions.explanation: 공지에 따르면 공사는 6월 16일부터 약 8주간 진행됩니다. 6월 16일에서 8주 후는 8월 중순이므로 Fairview Avenue 정류장은 8월 중순쯤 다시 운영될 것으로 추론할 수 있습니다. 날짜와 기간 정보를 결합해야 하는 계산 추론 문제입니다.

questions.question: What does Ms. Chen request in her e-mail?
options: A refund for her shuttle pass
An additional stop at Milton Plaza
More frequent Route B departures
A printed copy of the new schedule
questions.explanation: 이메일에서 'Would it be possible to add a stop at Milton Plaza, which is much closer to my building?'이라고 하며 자신의 건물과 가까운 Milton Plaza에 정류장을 추가해 달라고 요청하고 있습니다.

passage:
To: orders@quickpressprinting.com
From: n.pierce@sterlingevents.com
Date: August 26
Subject: Quote request — trade fair materials

Hello,
Sterling Events is preparing materials for a client's booth at the Riverton Trade Fair, and I would like a price estimate for the following: 500 tri-fold brochures in full color and 200 posters (18 × 24 inches). We will need everything delivered by September 12. Could you also let me know whether rush production is available and what it costs?
Thank you,
Noah Pierce, Project Coordinator

--- Passage 2 ---
QUOTE #QP-2291 — QuickPress Printing
Date: August 28 | Prepared for: Noah Pierce, Sterling Events
- Tri-fold brochures, full color: 500 × $0.62 = $310.00
- Posters, 18 × 24 in.: 200 × $7.50 = $1,500.00
Estimated total: $1,810.00
Standard turnaround: 10 business days from approval. Rush turnaround: 5 business days, plus 15% of the order total. A 50% deposit is required before production begins. This quote is valid for 30 days.

--- Passage 3 ---
To: orders@quickpressprinting.com
From: n.pierce@sterlingevents.com
Date: September 1
Subject: RE: Quote #QP-2291 — revisions

Hello,
We would like to go ahead with quote #QP-2291, with two changes. First, please reduce the poster quantity to 120; our client has scaled back the booth design. Second, the fair organizers have moved the event up to September 9, so we will need the rush turnaround after all. Please send a revised total reflecting the smaller quantity and the rush charge. I will pay the deposit today so that production can begin immediately.
Thank you,
Noah Pierce

questions.question: Why did Mr. Pierce first contact QuickPress Printing?
options: To complain about a late delivery
To ask for a price estimate
To schedule a facility tour
To cancel an existing order
questions.explanation: 첫 번째 이메일에서 'I would like a price estimate for the following'이라고 하며 브로슈어와 포스터 인쇄 견적을 요청하고 있습니다. 불만 제기나 주문 취소가 아니라 견적 문의가 목적입니다.

questions.question: According to the quote, what must Sterling Events do before production starts?
options: Pay half of the total cost
Approve a printed sample
Sign a one-year contract
Provide its own paper stock
questions.explanation: 견적서에 'A 50% deposit is required before production begins'라고 명시되어 있으므로 제작 시작 전에 총액의 50%를 보증금으로 지불해야 합니다.

questions.question: Why does Mr. Pierce now need rush production?
options: The printing company lost his first order.
His client increased the order quantity.
The trade fair date was moved earlier.
The standard service is no longer offered.
questions.explanation: 첫 이메일에서는 9월 12일까지 납품을 요청했지만, 세 번째 이메일에서 '주최 측이 행사를 9월 9일로 앞당겼다'고 하며 긴급 제작을 요청했습니다. 두 이메일을 비교해야 일정 변경이 이유임을 알 수 있는 연계 문제입니다.

questions.question: Before the rush charge, how much will the revised poster order cost?
questions.explanation: 견적서에서 포스터 단가는 $7.50이고, 수정 이메일에서 수량을 120장으로 줄여 달라고 했습니다. 따라서 120 × $7.50 = $900입니다. 견적서의 단가와 수정 요청의 수량을 결합해야 하는 연계 계산 문제입니다.

questions.question: What additional charge will be applied to the revised order?
options: A 15% rush surcharge
A weekend delivery fee
A design revision fee
A 30-day storage fee
questions.explanation: 견적서에 따르면 긴급 제작(5영업일)은 주문 총액의 15%가 추가되며, 수정 이메일에서 Pierce가 긴급 제작을 요청했으므로 15% 할증료가 부과됩니다. 두 지문을 연계해야 하는 문제입니다.

passage:
GREENFIELD CHAMBER OF COMMERCE
Small Business Excellence Award — Nomination Guidelines
Eligibility: Nominees must have operated within Greenfield for at least three years and employ fewer than 50 people. Any resident may nominate a business by submitting a letter describing the business's contributions to the community. Nomination letters are due by March 31. The winner will be announced at the Chamber's gala on May 6 and will receive a $5,000 grant along with a feature article in Commerce Quarterly magazine.

--- Passage 2 ---
March 24
Dear Selection Committee,
I am writing to nominate Birch & Vine Café for the Small Business Excellence Award. The café has been a fixture on Walnut Street for six years and employs eighteen local residents. Beyond serving excellent food, the café hosts monthly fund-raisers for the Greenfield Food Pantry and runs a composting program with the community garden. Owner Sam Whitaker also offers free barista training to high school students each summer. Few businesses give back to our town so generously.
Sincerely,
Olivia Tran

--- Passage 3 ---
PRESS RELEASE — May 7
The Greenfield Chamber of Commerce is pleased to announce that Birch & Vine Café has won this year's Small Business Excellence Award. Owner Sam Whitaker accepted the award at last night's gala before an audience of nearly 300 guests. The judging panel cited the café's deep community involvement, particularly its support of local charitable causes. Mr. Whitaker said the grant will be used to expand the café's summer job-training program for students. A profile of the café will appear in the summer issue of Commerce Quarterly.

questions.question: According to the guidelines, what is a requirement for nominees?
options: They must have at least 50 employees.
They must have operated in Greenfield for three or more years.
They must be members of the Chamber of Commerce.
They must nominate themselves in writing.
questions.explanation: 지침에 'Nominees must have operated within Greenfield for at least three years and employ fewer than 50 people'라고 명시되어 있습니다. 직원은 50명 미만이어야 하고, 추천은 주민 누구나 할 수 있으므로 나머지는 오답입니다.

questions.question: What is suggested about Birch & Vine Café?
options: It met the award's eligibility requirements.
It opened less than three years ago.
It is the largest employer in Greenfield.
It was nominated by its own employees.
questions.explanation: 지침의 자격 요건은 '3년 이상 운영, 직원 50명 미만'인데, 추천서에서 카페가 6년째 영업 중이고 직원이 18명이라고 했으므로 두 요건을 모두 충족합니다. 지침과 추천서를 연계해야 하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: What did the judging panel particularly value about the café?
options: Its low menu prices
Its support of community causes
Its rapid business growth
Its modern interior design
questions.explanation: 보도자료에서 심사위원단은 'the café's deep community involvement, particularly its support of local charitable causes'를 높이 평가했다고 밝혔습니다. 이는 추천서에 언급된 푸드 팬트리 모금 행사 등과 일치합니다.

questions.question: How does Mr. Whitaker plan to use the award money?
options: To open a second café location
To expand a training program mentioned in the nomination letter
To purchase new kitchen equipment
To fund an advertising campaign in a magazine
questions.explanation: 지침에 따르면 수상자는 $5,000의 지원금을 받으며, 보도자료에서 Whitaker는 이 지원금을 '학생을 위한 여름 직업 훈련 프로그램 확대'에 쓰겠다고 했습니다. 이 프로그램은 추천서에서 언급된 고교생 무료 바리스타 교육을 가리키므로 세 지문을 연계해야 정확히 풀 수 있습니다.

questions.question: What will Birch & Vine Café receive in addition to the grant?
options: A feature in a magazine
A year of free advertising on the radio
A plaque from the mayor
A booth at a trade fair
questions.explanation: 지침에서 수상자는 지원금과 함께 'a feature article in Commerce Quarterly magazine'을 받는다고 했고, 보도자료에서도 여름호에 카페 소개 기사가 실릴 예정이라고 확인했습니다.

MERIDIAN CRUISE LINES — 7-DAY ALASKA VOYAGE (Northern Star)
Day 1: Depart Vancouver, 4:00 P.M.
Day 2: Juneau (in port 8:00 A.M.–9:00 P.M.)
Day 3: Skagway (in port 7:00 A.M.–8:00 P.M.)

Day 5: Glacier viewing from the ship
Day 6: Ketchikan (in port 9:00 A.M.–6:00 P.M.)
Day 7: Return to Vancouver
Shore excursions may be booked until 48 hours before each port day. If an excursion is canceled by Meridian, guests are refunded automatically in onboard credit or, upon request, to the original form of payment.

--- Passage 2 ---
EXCURSION BOOKING CONFIRMATION — Northern Star
Guest: Greg Alvarez | Cabin: 7214
Excursion: Mendenhall Glacier Kayak Tour (Juneau, Day 2)
Participants: 2 | Price: $189.00 per person | Total: $378.00
Meeting point: Pier 3, 9:15 A.M. Please wear waterproof clothing. Paddling experience is not required; certified guides accompany all groups.

--- Passage 3 ---
IMPORTANT NOTICE TO GUESTS — Delivered to all cabins, Day 1, 8:30 P.M.
The National Weather Service has issued a high-wind advisory for the Juneau area tomorrow. For your safety, all water-based excursions scheduled for Day 2 have been canceled. Affected guests will automatically receive onboard credit for the full excursion price. Guests who prefer a refund to their original form of payment should visit the Guest Services desk on Deck 5 before 10:00 P.M. tonight. Limited spots on the Glacier Gardens Walking Tour, a land-based alternative, are being held for affected guests until 8:00 A.M. tomorrow.

questions.question: According to the itinerary, what will passengers do on Day 5?
options: Visit the port of Ketchikan
View glaciers from the ship
Go kayaking in Juneau
Return to Vancouver
questions.explanation: 일정표에 'Day 5: Glacier viewing from the ship'이라고 명시되어 있습니다. Ketchikan 기항은 6일 차, 밴쿠버 귀항은 7일 차입니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about the Mendenhall Glacier Kayak Tour?
options: It requires previous kayaking experience.
It departs directly from the ship.
Participants should wear waterproof clothing.
It lasts approximately four hours.
questions.explanation: 예약 확인서에 'Please wear waterproof clothing'이라고 안내되어 있습니다. 패들링 경험은 필요 없다고 했고, 집결지는 배가 아닌 Pier 3이며, 소요 시간은 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: Why will Mr. Alvarez be unable to take his excursion?
options: He booked less than 48 hours in advance.
Water-based activities in Juneau were canceled.
The tour was already fully booked.
The ship will skip the port of Juneau.
questions.explanation: 그가 예약한 것은 2일 차 주노의 카약 투어, 즉 수상 액티비티입니다. 공지에서 강풍 주의보로 인해 '2일 차의 모든 수상 기반 투어가 취소되었다'고 했으므로 그의 투어도 취소 대상입니다. 예약 확인서와 공지를 연계해야 하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: How much onboard credit will Mr. Alvarez receive if he takes no action?
questions.explanation: 공지에 따르면 영향을 받은 승객은 투어 요금 전액을 선상 크레딧으로 자동 환급받습니다. 예약 확인서에서 그의 결제 총액은 2인 × $189 = $378이므로, 별도 조치를 하지 않으면 $378의 선상 크레딧을 받게 됩니다. 두 지문의 정보를 결합해야 하는 계산 문제입니다.

questions.question: What should Mr. Alvarez do if he wants the money returned to his credit card?
options: Visit the Guest Services desk by 10:00 P.M.
Call the excursion operator in Juneau
Fill out a form at Pier 3
Wait until the ship returns to Vancouver
questions.explanation: 공지에서 '원래 결제 수단으로 환불받기를 원하는 승객은 오늘 밤 10시 전에 5층 Guest Services 데스크를 방문하라'고 안내했습니다. 이는 일정표의 환불 규정(요청 시 원결제 수단 환불)과도 일치합니다.

During the closure, our bookmobile will visit five neighborhood locations each week; the schedule is posted at ashfordlibrary.org. The outdoor book drop will remain open, and due dates for all borrowed items have been extended to September 8. ashfordlibrary.org/volunteer

Work dates: June 23–28, with morning shifts (9:00 A.M.–noon) and afternoon shifts (1:00–4:00 P.M.). questions.question: Why was the notice issued?
options: To announce a temporary library closure
To advertise a new bookmobile route
To request donations for a renovation
To introduce a new head librarian

questions.question: During which hours will Mr. Osei most likely volunteer?
options: 9:00 A.M. to noon
Noon to 3:00 P.M.
questions.explanation: 이메일에서 Delgado는 Osei가 '오후 시프트 세 번'에 신청해 준 것에 감사한다고 했고, 웹페이지에 따르면 오후 시프트는 1시부터 4시까지입니다. 두 지문을 연계해야 그의 봉사 시간대를 알 수 있습니다.

questions.question: What event will Mr. Osei be able to attend before the library officially reopens?
options: An author talk on September 6
A preview night on September 5
A children's activity day in August
A bookmobile launch ceremony
questions.explanation: 웹페이지에서 자원봉사자는 9월 5일 프리뷰 나이트에 초대된다고 했고, 이메일에서도 그의 초대장이 8월에 발송될 것이라고 확인했습니다. 공지에 따르면 일반 공개 재개관 행사는 9월 6일이므로, 그는 공식 재개관 전날 행사에 참석할 수 있습니다. 세 지문의 날짜 정보를 종합해야 하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: What is Mr. Osei asked to do if he wants an additional assignment?
options: Reply to Ms. Delgado's e-mail
Fill out a form on the Web site
Call the library's front desk
Visit the temporary storage facility
questions.explanation: 이메일 마지막에서 8월 마지막 주 책 재배치 작업에 참여할 수 있다면 'simply reply to this e-mail'이라고 했으므로, 이메일에 회신하면 명단에 추가됩니다.

questions.question: Where is Mr. Osei instructed to park during moving week?
options: In the lot behind the building
In the front parking lot
On the street near the book drop
At a nearby neighborhood location
questions.explanation: 이메일에서 '앞쪽 주차장은 이삿짐 트럭이 사용할 예정이므로 건물 뒤편 주차장을 이용하라'고 안내했습니다.

questions.question: According to the invitation, what will happen at the end of the webinar?

Participants can ask questions live.

questions.question: Why did Ms. Brooks miss the webinar?

Her audio equipment failed.

The session reached full capacity.

questions.question: By when should Ms. Brooks receive the recording link?

By the afternoon of July 11
By the evening of July 12
By the end of July
questions.explanation: 등록 확인서에 따르면 녹화 링크는 웨비나 종료 후 48시간 이내에 발송됩니다. 웨비나는 7월 9일 오후에 끝났으므로 48시간 후인 7월 11일 오후까지 도착해야 하며, Raj도 'It should arrive by tomorrow afternoon'(대화일 7월 10일 기준 다음 날)이라고 말했습니다. 확인서와 문자 대화의 정보를 결합해야 하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: At 10:08 A.M., why does Mr. Patel write, "The confirmation said within 48 hours, remember?"

To reassure Ms. Brooks that the e-mail is not late yet
To complain that the company is slow to respond
To suggest that Ms. Brooks contact technical support
questions.explanation: Brooks가 녹화 영상이 아직 도착하지 않았다고 하자, Patel은 확인서에 안내된 '48시간 이내' 규정을 상기시키며 내일 오후까지는 도착할 것이라고 안심시키고 있습니다. 의도 파악 문제로, 발송이 아직 지연된 것이 아님을 알려 주려는 의도입니다.

questions.question: What is suggested about Maple Hollow Apiary's products?
options: They satisfy the market's distance requirement.
They are purchased from other local farms.
They are sold only during the summer.
They require refrigeration at the booth.
questions.explanation: 지침에서 판매자는 Riverside에서 100마일 이내에서 직접 생산한 제품만 팔 수 있다고 했는데, 신청서에 양봉장이 40마일 거리에 있고 모든 제품을 직접 생산한다고 기재되어 있습니다. 따라서 거리 요건을 충족함을 두 지문 연계로 알 수 있습니다.

questions.question: Which of Ms. Cho's requests was NOT granted?

Her request for a spot near the entrance

questions.explanation: 신청서에서 그녀는 정문 근처 코너 부스를 요청했지만, 승인 이메일에서 코너 부스는 연차순으로 배정되어 첫해 판매자인 그녀는 대기자 명단에 올랐고 중앙 통로의 22번 부스에서 시작한다고 했습니다. 신청서와 회신을 비교하는 연계 문제입니다.

questions.question: How much must Ms. Cho pay by April 15?
questions.explanation: 세 지문 연계 문제입니다. 신청서에서 그녀는 시즌 전체 부스를 신청했고, 이메일에서 '시즌 요금은 4월 15일까지 납부'하라고 했으며, 지침에 따르면 시즌 부스 요금은 $400입니다. 따라서 $400를 내야 합니다.

questions.question: What must Ms. Cho do on April 26?
options: Pay her weekly booth fee
Attend a new-vendor orientation
Set up her booth for the first market
Renew her insurance certificate
questions.explanation: 이메일에서 '모든 신규 판매자는 4월 26일 토요일 오전 10시에 마켓 사무실에서 열리는 오리엔테이션에 참석해야 한다'고 안내했습니다. 첫 장날은 5월 2일입니다.

Invoice date: December 10 | Account #: TB-30992

questions.question: According to the offer, what do early renewers receive in addition to the magazine?

Access to a digital archive

questions.question: Why does the invoice show a charge of $48?
options: It includes a fee for digital archive access.
It reflects the standard rate applied after November 30.
It covers two years of issues.
It includes a late-payment penalty.

questions.question: Why does Mr. Mendes believe the invoice is incorrect?
options: He canceled his subscription in November.
He already renewed and paid before the offer deadline.
He was promised a free year of service.
He never received the December issue.
questions.explanation: 세 지문을 종합해야 하는 문제입니다. 프로모션 마감일은 11월 30일이고, Mendes는 11월 22일에 온라인으로 갱신·결제했으며 확인번호 TR-5520도 받았다고 했습니다. 즉 기한 내에 이미 $36 프로모션 요금으로 결제를 마쳤으므로 $48 청구서 자체가 잘못 발행된 것입니다.

questions.question: What problem does Mr. Mendes mention about his account?
options: His delivery address is outdated.
His confirmation number was never issued.
He cannot access the digital archive.
His subscription was shortened to six months.
questions.explanation: 이메일에서 그는 프로모션 혜택인 디지털 아카이브가 'still shows a message saying the archive is locked'라며 이용할 수 없다고 했습니다. 이는 프로모션 안내의 혜택과 비교되는 연계 정보입니다.

questions.question: What does Mr. Mendes ask the magazine to do?
options: Extend his subscription by one year
Send him a copy of the February issue
Correct his records and cancel the invoice
Refund his payment of $48
questions.explanation: 이메일 마지막에서 'Please correct my account records, cancel the invoice, and activate my archive access'라고 요청했습니다. 그는 $48를 결제한 적이 없으므로 환불 요청은 해당되지 않습니다.

passage:
LUMEN PHOTOGRAPHY SOCIETY — ANNUAL CONTEST
This year's theme: "Urban Reflections"
Rules: Each photographer may submit up to three entries. All photographs must have been taken within the twelve months preceding the submission deadline. Minor adjustments to brightness and contrast are permitted, but heavy digital alteration is not. Entries are due by February 28. Winners and honorable mentions will be notified by March 20, and selected works will be displayed at the society's spring exhibition in April at the Calder Gallery.

Name: Daniel Okafor | Member since: last year
Date submitted: February 25
Entry 1: "Glass River" — taken last October, Hadley Financial District
Entry 2: "Midnight Crosswalk" — taken in January of this year, Seventh Avenue
Entry 3: "Rainlight" — taken in December two years ago, Union Square
I confirm that all editing was limited to brightness and contrast. — D.O.

--- Passage 3 ---
To: d.okafor@lentamail.com

Date: March 18
Subject: Contest results

questions.question: What is indicated about the contest?

It allows each entrant up to three photographs.
It requires entries to be printed and mailed.

questions.question: Why was "Rainlight" most likely disqualified?

It was taken more than twelve months before the deadline.
It did not match the contest theme.
It was submitted after February 28.

questions.question: Which photograph will be displayed at the Calder Gallery?
options: "Glass River"
"Midnight Crosswalk"
"Rainlight"
All three of Mr. Okafor's entries
questions.explanation: 이메일에서 'Glass River'가 가작(honorable mention)으로 선정되어 봄 전시회에 전시된다고 했고, 규정에 따르면 전시 장소는 Calder Gallery입니다. 두 지문을 연계한 문제입니다.

questions.question: What is suggested about Mr. Okafor's submission?
options: It was sent before the deadline.
It was his fifth time entering the contest.
It included more entries than allowed.
It was edited by a professional retoucher.
questions.explanation: 출품 마감일은 2월 28일인데 제출 양식의 제출일이 2월 25일이므로 기한 내에 제출했음을 알 수 있습니다. 규정과 제출 양식을 비교해야 하는 연계 문제입니다.

questions.question: What is Mr. Okafor invited to do on April 3?
options: Pick up his disqualified photograph
Attend the exhibition's opening reception
Serve as a judge for next year's contest
Give a lecture on urban photography
questions.explanation: 이메일에서 4월 3일 오후 6시에 열리는 전시회 개막 리셉션에 참석해 달라고 초대하며, 그의 액자 작품이 전시되어 있을 것이라고 안내했습니다.

passage:
MEMO — Corbett & Hale Insurance, Facilities Department
To: All staff | Date: July 21 | Re: New recycling program
Beginning August 1, single-stream recycling bins will be placed in the kitchen area of every floor. Paper, cardboard, glass, and rigid plastics may all go in the same bin. Please note: plastic bags of any kind are NOT accepted and will cause an entire bin to be rejected by our hauler. Electronic waste will be collected separately on a quarterly basis; see the posted schedule. Our goal is to reduce the building's landfill waste by 40 percent within one year.

--- Passage 2 ---
RECYCLING & E-WASTE SCHEDULE — Corbett & Hale Insurance
Regular recycling pickup: every Tuesday and Friday
Quarterly e-waste collection dates: September 12, December 12, March 13, June 12
E-waste drop-off: Bring items to Room B04 during the week before each collection date. Accepted items include computers, monitors, keyboards, cables, and telephones. Batteries must be taped at the terminals.

--- Passage 3 ---
To: facilities@corbetthale.com
From: g.lindqvist@corbetthale.com
Date: September 3
Subject: A few recycling questions

Hello,
Three quick things. First, I have an old monitor and a keyboard under my desk — where exactly should I take them, and when? Second, the recycling bin on the fifth floor has been overflowing by Thursday every week; could an extra pickup be added? Third, our team shreds a large amount of paper, and the shredding service leaves it bundled in plastic bags. Can we put those bags straight into the bins, or will that be a problem?
Thanks,
Greta Lindqvist, Claims Department

questions.question: What is one purpose of the memo?
options: To explain a new recycling program
To announce the hiring of a new hauler
To request volunteers for a cleanup day
To report that a waste-reduction goal was met
questions.explanation: 메모는 8월 1일부터 시행되는 새 재활용 프로그램(단일 분리수거함 설치, 금지 품목, 전자폐기물 별도 수거, 감축 목표)을 안내하기 위한 것입니다. 목표는 아직 달성된 것이 아니라 향후 1년간의 목표입니다.

questions.question: When can Ms. Lindqvist most likely drop off her monitor?
options: During the week before September 12
On any Tuesday or Friday
On December 12 only
During the first week of August
questions.explanation: 일정표에 따르면 전자폐기물은 각 수거일 전 주에 Room B04로 가져가야 하며, 9월 3일 현재 가장 가까운 수거일은 9월 12일입니다. 따라서 9월 12일 직전 주에 모니터를 가져가면 됩니다. 이메일의 날짜와 일정표를 연계해야 하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: What problem would the shredded paper most likely cause?
options: It would be too heavy for the bins.
Its plastic bags would cause the bin to be rejected.
It could only be collected quarterly.
It would need to be taped before disposal.
questions.explanation: 이메일에서 파쇄 서비스 업체가 파쇄지를 비닐봉지에 담아 둔다고 했는데, 메모에서 '어떤 종류의 비닐봉지도 허용되지 않으며 수거업체가 수거함 전체를 거부하는 원인이 된다'고 경고했습니다. 두 지문을 연계하면 비닐봉지째 버리면 문제가 됨을 알 수 있습니다.

questions.question: What does Ms. Lindqvist report about the fifth floor?
options: Its kitchen area has no recycling bin.
Its bin fills up before the week's second pickup.
Its staff refuse to separate their waste.
Its e-waste was not collected on time.
questions.explanation: 이메일에서 5층 수거함이 매주 목요일이면 넘친다고 보고했습니다. 일정표상 정기 수거는 화요일과 금요일이므로, 금요일 수거 전에 가득 찬다는 의미이며 그래서 추가 수거를 요청한 것입니다.

questions.question: According to the schedule, what is required when recycling batteries?
options: They must be removed from devices.
Their terminals must be taped.
They must be placed in clear bags.
They must be registered with facilities.
questions.explanation: 일정표 마지막에 'Batteries must be taped at the terminals'라고 명시되어 있으므로 배터리는 단자 부분을 테이프로 감싸야 합니다.

questions.question: Why does Bluepeak Robotics need electrical service?

questions.question: How much extra would Bluepeak Robotics pay to move to a premium corner booth?

questions.question: What is most likely true about the badge for Dana Liu?
options: It will cost the company $40.

questions.question: According to the confirmation, how should a booth change be requested?
options: In writing
By telephone
In person during setup
Through a staff member's badge account
questions.explanation: 예약 확인서의 비고에 '부스 배정 변경은 공간이 허락할 때만 가능하며 요청은 서면으로 해야 한다(Requests must be made in writing)'고 명시되어 있습니다. Marini가 이메일로 업그레이드를 요청한 것도 이 규정에 따른 것입니다.

passage:
ELMWOOD COMMUNITY GARDEN — PLOT RULES
1. Plots cost $40 per season and are assigned by lottery each March.
2. Gardeners must tend their plots at least once a week during the growing season.
3. Water is available from the shared spigots located along the north and south fences.
4. Shared tools are kept in the locked shed; the entry code is provided with each plot assignment.
5. Plots left unattended for three weeks or longer may be reassigned to the waiting list unless arrangements have been made with the garden committee.

--- Passage 2 ---
April 2
Dear Ms. Tanaka,
Congratulations! In this year's lottery you have been assigned Plot 17, located near the north fence. The season runs from April 15 to October 31. Your seasonal fee is due by April 12; you may pay online or by check. The shed entry code is enclosed on the card in this envelope — please do not share it with non-members. We also invite you to our welcome workday on Saturday, April 19, where returning gardeners will share tips with new members.
Elmwood Garden Committee

--- Passage 3 ---
To: committee@elmwoodgarden.org
From: y.tanaka@hartfield.net
Date: June 5
Subject: Broken spigot and summer travel

Hello,
Two matters. First, the spigot closest to my plot has been broken for about two weeks, so I have been carrying water all the way from the opposite fence, which takes considerable time. Could a repair be scheduled soon? Second, I will be traveling for four weeks in July and August. My neighbor in Plot 16 has kindly agreed to water and weed my plot while I am away. Could you confirm that this arrangement means my plot will not be given to someone else? Thank you for all you do.
Yuki Tanaka

questions.question: According to the rules, how are garden plots assigned?
options: On a first-come, first-served basis
By a lottery held each March
By seniority of membership
Through an interview with the committee
questions.explanation: 규칙 1번에 '구획은 매년 3월 추첨(lottery)으로 배정된다'고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.question: How much was Ms. Tanaka required to pay by April 12?
options: Nothing — the plot is free
questions.explanation: 배정 통지서에서 시즌 요금을 4월 12일까지 납부하라고 했고, 규칙 1번에 따르면 구획 요금은 시즌당 $40입니다. 두 지문을 연계해야 금액을 알 수 있습니다.

questions.question: Which spigot is most likely broken?
options: The one near the north fence
The one near the south fence
The one inside the tool shed
The one beside the garden entrance
questions.explanation: 규칙에 따르면 수도는 북쪽과 남쪽 울타리에 있고, 배정 통지서에서 Tanaka의 Plot 17은 북쪽 울타리 근처입니다. 이메일에서 '내 구획에서 가장 가까운 수도가 고장 나 반대쪽 울타리에서 물을 길어 온다'고 했으므로 고장 난 것은 북쪽 울타리의 수도입니다. 세 지문의 위치 정보를 종합해야 하는 추론 문제입니다.

questions.question: Why is Ms. Tanaka concerned about her summer travel?
options: Plots left untended for three weeks may be reassigned.
The garden closes completely during August.
Her seasonal fee will increase if she is away.
The shed code changes every month.
questions.explanation: 규칙 5번에서 '3주 이상 방치된 구획은 대기자에게 재배정될 수 있다'고 했는데, 그녀의 여행 기간은 4주입니다. 그래서 이웃이 대신 관리하는 것으로 재배정을 피할 수 있는지 확인을 요청한 것입니다. 규칙과 이메일을 연계해야 하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: What has Ms. Tanaka arranged with the gardener in Plot 16?
options: To share the cost of her plot
To care for her plot during her absence
To trade plots for the rest of the season
To repair the broken spigot together
questions.explanation: 이메일에서 'Plot 16의 이웃이 내가 없는 동안 물 주기와 잡초 제거를 해 주기로 흔쾌히 동의했다'고 했으므로, 여행 중 구획 관리를 부탁한 것입니다.
